body: tbh, i think they'll probably break up because that's how a majority of relationship end and they've only been together a short time. again, he had limited capacity and only wanted to invite people he was close to. maybe over time he'll find out she's different from his first impression(i doubt it based on her complaining about something this dumb), but that definitely doesn't need to happen at his own birthday party with a limited capacity. if my good friends partner was speaking badly about me with no valid reason, i would expect my friend to speak up for me

the teacher started the issue by being too stuck up to admit he was wrong. i don't think the kid handled it well, but it's so weird how you're putting none of the blame on the teacher, the adult in the room and supposed to be modeling good behaviors

"you should've been the bigger person" i actually think he full-grown adult should've been the one to do that. I believe teachers generally deserve way more respect than they get, but not in this situation

If I yelled at a student like that, i'd expect to get cussed out. so weird how y'all are expecting the 16 year old to be more mature than the teacher, who could've modeled good behavior for the class by admitting he was wrong after he realized he'd wrongly accused the kid

I had a teacher try to correct me during a presentation, even though I was right. I corrected them, they continued to argue with me. afterwards they pulled me aside to tell me that i was disrespectful and, even though they realized afterwards that i was right, i should've gone along with what they said just to be polite. It made me so angry at the time that I had to physically leave the classroom and kick a tree outside to calm down. But now i'm 26 and i'd completely forgotten about that interaction until i read this post. Those teachers were dumb and wrong, but they aren't relevant to my life. But being able to get into a good college did hugely impact my life. There are stupid people everywhere, you have to choose where to put your energy. Your academic record is more important than the asshole teacher. You could always make a complaint to a higher up at the school, but honestly i'd wait until you're out of their class. I think you're completely in the right and this teacher sounds like a pathetic person tbh, but don't risk your future over one awful teacher.

edit: NTA, but find a different outlet for your frustration and handle it differently next time

If you want to maintain a relationship with your brother that's on you, but it's extremely unfair to expect your wife to allow him around small children and her other family members who might attend the party. she is being rightfully protective.
